title: Keep scores like 2–0 on one line on tablets (Live Corrections, League Night, live match)
request: please fix everything that comes up, dont just wait until you are done with a task to ask me if you can fix (the tablet audit found score text such as 2–0 splitting across two lines on Live Corrections, League Night status and the live match page)

criteria.text: Live Corrections round rows (/admin/live-corrections, 768-940px): the score (N – N) never splits across two lines; before: 14 of 21 round rows split
Live Corrections game card title (968-1000px): the score never splits; before: '21 –' on one line and '16' on the next

League Night status, Unrecorded live matches (744-1016px): the score stays on one line and the spaces between name, score and date are back; before: 2 of 3 rows showed '2–' and '0' on two lines and no spaces
League Night status, drift card: 'stored W-L' and 'derived W-L' never split; before: 'derived 9-' and '1' at 776px
Live match page (/matches/<id>/live), 'wins the match' panel: the score stays on one line at 768 and 1024px; before: '2–' and '1' on two lines
Live match, Save official result dialog: each 'Game N: A 17–21 B' score stays on one line; before: '17–' and '21' on two lines

Nothing else moves: same visible text on every touched screen, no new console errors, no sideways page scroll, existing tests pass (two assertions read the whole text because the score now sits in its own no-break span)

reviews.summary: Plan review: lines VERIFIED. Missing from the test list: LiveMatchView.test.tsx:900 and MatchCorrectionsPanel.test.tsx:243 (own-text matches that break when the score gets its own span); use toHaveTextContent on the li/h2/h3. Optional: content-center on the flex-wrap link; group 'stored a-b' and 'derived c-d' as units. Lead takes all of them.
